title: Run CrewAI autolog tests with pinned crewai and litellm versions via uv
answers: how to run crewai autolog tests
pytest crewai tests with specific crewai version
uv run crewai test litellm version pin
why does crewai test fail with litellm 1.97.0
body:
Command: uv run --frozen --with 'crewai==1.15.17' --with 'litellm!=1.97.0,<1.98.0' pytest tests/crewai/test_crewai_autolog.py
--frozen keeps the lockfile resolution, so the repo lock is not re-solved.
--with adds crewai at the pinned version on top of the lockfile environment for this run only.
The litellm constraint excludes 1.97.x, which the test suite does not support, so do not drop it.
The end-to-end test test_kickoff_trace_does_not_expose_llm_api_key mocks litellm.completion and needs litellm installed.
applies: Applies when running or debugging tests in tests/crewai/ on this repository.
says: CrewAI autologging tests fail when running against unsupported versions of the underlying language model library.
